source_citation: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository.

cancellation_matching.rule: Whole-row same calendar day/SKU/Decimal price/absolute quantity/country/nonempty exact CustomerID; one-to-one source-row FIFO
cancellation_matching.interpretation: Post-hoc audit-driven data-quality sensitivity; not preregistered; pairing does not prove original invoice correspondence

selection: Top retained positive units in training only after chosen cancellation policy; lexical SKU tie-break
acquisition_cost_assumption: Training quantity-weighted selling price times cost_ratio; half-up pence; minimum 1p
zero_fill: All absent SKU/calendar-day sales become zero; closure vs missing vs stockout unknown
demand_caveat: Recorded sales are not latent demand. Replenishment, cost and lost-sales outcomes are hypothetical.
interpretation: Single historical gross-sales path; hypothetical policy replay, not a randomized trial
